audience: Swiss small business owners and bookkeepers who run invoicing and accounting in bexio

useCases.title: Find open and overdue sales invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by status, such as pending or partly paid, with totals, open amount and dates. It opens one for its positions and received payments.

useCases.title: Check supplier bills that are due
useCases.text: The AI lists supplier bills by status (to do, paid, overdue) with vendor, due date, gross amount and pending amount, and adds up what is still to pay.

useCases.title: Review journal bookings and the chart of accounts
useCases.text: The AI lists journal entries with date, debit and credit accounts, amount and source document, and the chart of accounts, tax codes and business years.

useCases.title: Look up contacts, quotes and orders
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts and opens one, and lists quotes and orders with status and totals.

useCases.title: Log time on a project
useCases.text: The AI adds a timesheet entry with date and duration, or start and end, using one of your business activities. You can first list existing timesheets.

useCases.title: Add a contact or note, or draft an invoice
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, adds a note to a contact or project, or creates a draft invoice. The draft is not issued or sent, so you review it in bexio.
